scientific limitations/integrity: The claim concerns the controlled and uncontrolled equations as printed in the 2026 source. The incidence mismatch needs \(c\ne1\) and positive \(ASI\); the recovery-balance defect needs \(u_1<1\) and positive recovery flux. The proposed repair is minimal and flow-consistent but is not presented as a full reanalysis of the optimal-control problem. The corrected stationarity formula uses a \(B_1u_1^2/2\) running-cost normalization; other quadratic conventions only rescale its denominator.
title: The published SEIQHRA control system fails its unit-control and transfer-balance checks
